passenger_response.subject: Update on booking AER-7T3M1B
passenger_response.body:
Dear Chidi Okonkwo,

Our record shows that flight AK220 on 2026-08-05 was cancelled because a hydraulic system fault was identified during the pre-flight inspection. The aircraft was withdrawn from service and no replacement aircraft was available at the station.

Part of this needs a colleague to look at, and it has been passed to them. No decision has been made on it yet.

We have not moved Ngozi Okonkwo onto another flight yet. Her booked wheelchair assistance has to be arranged on the new flight first, and a colleague who can do that has the case.

The refund has not been issued. The booking record does not hold a separate ticket price for each passenger, so the exact amount has to be confirmed by a colleague before any money moves. The entitlement to a refund itself is not in doubt.

Part of this needs a colleague to look at, and it has been passed to them. No decision has been made on it yet.

As the flight was cancelled, care is owed immediately. This includes meals and refreshments up to £30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, hotel accommodation up to £180 per room per night for a maximum of 3 nights, subject to station allocation, and transport up to £45 per journey.

We cannot work out compensation yet. It depends on how late you actually arrive at your final destination, and that is not known until your new flight has run. It will be assessed then. Do not read this as a decision either way.

Regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
